skill_outcomes.skill_name: Introduction to logistics and supply chain management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the approach, nature, activities, roles, trends, objects, scope, and basic contents of logistics and supply chain management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Nature and classification of logistics products
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature, classification, characteristics of logistics products; the 80/20 principle and ABC analysis in logistics management; packaging and pricing of logistics products.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Customer service decision-making in logistics operations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain how to make decisions about customer service in logistics operations.
Understand and explain the information system in logistics operations.
Understand and explain the role, components, and selection criteria for transportation services.
Understand and explain inventory management principles including push and pull strategies.
Understand and explain the strategic planning process in supply chain management.
Actively participate in class discussions, ask questions, and present ideas.
Prepare for seminars by reading materials and completing assignments.
Work collaboratively with peers in group projects, presenting findings and defending ideas.
